summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue $16,000,000 in bonds, levied at about $30 per $100,000 of assessed value while outstanding, to modernize classrooms and facilities and make health, safety, and security improvements.

tax.text: A Yes vote would authorize up to $16 million in school bonds repaid through property-tax levies.
tax.quote: This measure will authorize bonds of up to $16 million, repaid through levies of $30 per $100,000 of assessed valuation on land parcels within the district.

tax.text: The No position opposes authorizing $16 million in school bonds repaid through property-tax levies of $30 per $100,000 of assessed value.
tax.quote: This measure will authorize bonds of up to $16 million, repaid through levies of $30 per $100,000 of assessed valuation on land parcels within the district.
